2.translation: In a fresh R session, run the code below, then follow this page in order. Colours and layout are optional display choices; inputs select only the fields needed.

7.translation: The example uses ⟦shared:0⟧ from this page. If you already have a plot, use your plot object in its place.

9.translation: For circular plots, omit both dimensions to estimate the preview size. For chord and collinear plots, supply a width and use ⟦shared:0⟧ to estimate height. A webpage also scales a thumbnail to its content column, so increasing dpi alone does not enlarge its text.

10.translation: After checking text, labels and legends, save at the same dimensions.

12.translation:
⟦shared:0⟧ returns a temporary image path; it does not keep a final export.
The website, README and vignettes share PNG previews generated with
⟦shared:0⟧ at sizes listed in the [gallery](⟦shared:1⟧). They do not capture an
interactively resized panel. Use your intended PDF/SVG device explicitly for
final vector output; font availability and embedding remain device-dependent.

15.translation: Use matching dimensions for preview and saving. Inspect text, guides and warnings; a successful measurement does not certify fonts or release quality across devices.

18.translation: PNG serves web pages and slides; PDF/SVG serve vector-output workflows. The extension selects the default device unless a device is explicitly supplied. Reuse the target dimensions above and check fonts and embedding in the final file.

21.translation: | Question | Call and result | Rows and units |

23.translation: | Where did an input link go? | ⟦shared:1⟧ and ⟦shared:2⟧ from ⟦shared:0⟧ | Look up the row in its layer input. A statistic can have several members in ⟦shared:3⟧. Polygon rows describe vertices. Count observations in the source table. |

24.translation: | Where is a base or residue drawn? | ⟦shared:0⟧ returns ⟦shared:1⟧, ⟦shared:2⟧, ⟦shared:3⟧ and ⟦shared:4⟧ | Source positions are in bp or aa. Display coordinates use layout units. Select an axis for a dot plot. |

25.translation: | Is the plot legible at the intended size? | ⟦shared:1⟧ and diagnostics from ⟦shared:0⟧ | Check panel measurement status on the target device before reading bounds in mm. In ordinary exports, ⟦shared:2⟧ identifies layout estimates or existing measurements. |

26.translation: | How do the panels line up? | ⟦shared:1⟧ and child layouts from ⟦shared:0⟧ | Global composition geometry uses mm. Look up source positions in the corresponding child panel. |
